title: Have got / Has got
summary: Use have got and has got to talk about possession and relationships.

explanation.en: Have got means 'have'. Use has got with he, she and it.
explanation.ru: Have got означает «иметь». С he, she, it используется has got.

forms.label: Positive
forms.pattern: I/You/We/They have got · He/She/It has got

examples.en: I have got a new bike.

forms.label: Questions
forms.pattern: Have you got ...? · Has she got ...?

commonMistakes.note: Use has got with he, she and it.

commonMistakes.wrong: Do you have got a bike?
commonMistakes.note: In the have got pattern, form questions with have/has.
